description: Eight clock dividers driving triggers, gates and four summed voltage columns, with randomisers on every group of controls

params.text: Advances the sequence one step, as a rising edge at the clock jack does
Sets the step count back to zero, as a rising edge at the reset jack does
Applies the nudge or randomise action to all thirty-two voltage knobs at once
Sets how far a nudge moves a voltage knob, 0 to 1
Picks what the randomise buttons do: Nudge moves a control up or down by the nudge amount, Random replaces it with a new value anywhere in its range
Sets how often that row fires, once every 1 to 64 steps of the clock; at 0 the row never fires
Sets that row's contribution to the first column output, -1V to 1V, counted only on the steps where the row fires
Sets that row's contribution to the second column output, -1V to 1V, counted only on the steps where the row fires
Sets that row's contribution to the third column output, -1V to 1V, counted only on the steps where the row fires
Sets that row's contribution to the fourth column output, -1V to 1V, counted only on the steps where the row fires
Applies the nudge or randomise action to all eight voltage knobs in that column
Applies the nudge or randomise action to the four voltage knobs in that row
Held down, that row's divider is left alone by the divider randomiser
Sets the chance that row produces a trigger and a gate on a step where it fires, 0 for never and 1 for always
Applies the nudge or randomise action to all eight dividers, skipping any row whose lock is held
Multiplies that column's summed voltage before it reaches the output, -5 to 5
Nothing in the module reads this knob; the second column's offset knob is added to all four column outputs, because the code offsets every column with the same knob
Adds -5V to 5V to every column output, not only to the second one

inputs.text: A rising edge here advances the sequence one step
A rising edge here sets the step count back to zero
A rising edge here applies the nudge or randomise action to all thirty-two voltage knobs
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the divider randomiser can be fired only from the button beside it
A rising edge here applies the nudge or randomise action to all eight voltage knobs in that column
A rising edge here applies the nudge or randomise action to the four voltage knobs in that row

outputs.text: Sends a 1ms pulse whenever any row fires and its probability lets it through
Goes to 10V on any step where at least one row fires, and back to 0V on a step where none does
Sends a 1ms pulse on the steps where that row fires and its probability lets it through
Goes to 10V on a step where that row fires and its probability lets it through, and stays high until the next step
Carries that column's summed voltage: the knobs of every row that fired on this step, added together, multiplied by the column's scale knob and offset

notes: a row only fires when the step count divides exactly by its divider setting, so a row set to 4 fires on every fourth clock
the code reads the second column's offset knob for all four columns, so turning the first, third or fourth changes nothing and turning the second shifts every column
